method: NDOT's own rest-areas-welcome-centers page (dot.nv.gov) returned HTTP 403 to a direct fetch, and an August 2026 Wayback Machine snapshot of that page contained only navigation chrome with no rest-area list or policy text -- the page is JS-rendered and its content did not resolve in the archive. Coordinates and facility notes below are therefore taken from a secondary rest-area directory site, not NDOT directly. This is flagged in verified/notes per the honesty rules.

records.name: Wadsworth Rest Area (I-80 westbound, mile marker ~42-43)
records.notes: Location and mile marker from camping.org and nevadarestareas.com (secondary/user-report aggregators), not NDOT's own site -- dot.nv.gov blocked automated fetch (403) and its Wayback snapshot had no usable content. Westbound-access-only, I-80 near Wadsworth, the last formal rest stop before the climb into Reno on this corridor. Overnight-policy reports directly conflict between sources: one summary (citing NDOT generally) states an 18-hour limit within any 2-week period with sleeping in the vehicle permitted; a different rest-area review site states a flat 24-hour limit with 'no overnight parking and no overnight camping,' napping only. Could not independently confirm either against an official NDOT source -- verify posted signage on arrival, do not assume either rule holds.
